看到赵安坤这神色，刘航心里瞬间揪紧了，紧张得咽了口唾沫，小心翼翼地问道：“赵师傅，找到问题了吗？”

赵安坤摇了摇头，语气里带着几分疑惑：“麻烦就麻烦在，我压根没找到任何问题。”

赵安坤又走到院子里，停下脚步，双手背在身后，仔细思索起来，吴姜此时也凑到了他的身前。

“赵叔，不是厂子里风水出了问题吗？”

赵安坤又是摇了摇头，对吴姜说道：“这里的风水还是不错的，我就简单点和你说吧，太复杂了你也听不懂。”

“刘老板的厂子，地势平整开阔，也没有路冲、天斩煞、尖角冲射和污秽污染源，办公楼还在旺位上，院子里种的那几棵树也是有讲究的。”

说到这里，赵安坤转向刘航问道：“刘老板，你这厂子的布局，是特意请风水师傅看过的吗？”

刘航连忙摇了摇头，说道：“我租下来就是这样，没有改动过，听说整个园区的布局都是工业园的老板请人设计的。”

赵安坤点了点头，“那就对了，这里绝对是请高人指点过。”

吴姜皱了皱眉，又提出一个猜测：“赵叔，既然看不出问题，是不是刘哥得罪人了，有人故意暗中害他？”

这次还没等赵安坤开口，刘航自己就先摇着头否决了。

“不应该啊，我也就是个小老板，平时也没得罪过人，谁会闲的没事来害我啊？”

赵安坤也认可他这个说法，别看刘航一年也能挣个几百万，但在深市，比他挣得多的人，可以说是一抓一大把，要真是人为的，那花的代价绝对不小。

吴姜又提出了一个观点，“既然阳宅和厂子都没问题，那是不是阴宅出问题了？”

这个就是赵安坤疑惑的地方了，阴宅出问题确实会影响后人运势，但一般来说，阴宅出问题，反应都在后代身上，比如后代破财、生病、诸事不顺。

刘航的公司这些都能对得上，但他公司的员工频繁出事，这就说不通了。

赵安坤将自己的想法说了，这下子又陷入僵局了。

赵安坤眉头紧锁，双手背在身后，反复踱步，半晌后，他终于下定决心：“刘老板，事到如今，只能去看看你家的阴宅了。你家祖坟在什么地方？最近有没有什么变动？”

刘航闻言，连忙说道：“赵师傅，我家祖坟在老家，也是苍名县的，过年的时候，我爸去祭拜了，没发现什么异常啊。”

Seeing Zhao Ankun's look, Liu Hang's heart tightened instantly. He swallowed nervously and asked cautiously: "Master Zhao, have you found the problem?"

Zhao Ankun shook his head, with a bit of confusion in his tone: "The trouble is the trouble, I didn't find any problem at all."

Zhao Ankun walked into the yard again, stopped, put his hands behind his back, and thought carefully. Wu Jiang also approached him at this time.

"Uncle Zhao, isn't there something wrong with the feng shui in the factory?"

Zhao Ankun shook his head again and said to Wu Jiang: "The Feng Shui here is pretty good. I'll tell you in a simple way. It's too complicated for you to understand."

"Boss Liu's factory has a flat and open terrain, and there are no road rushes, sky-cutting evil, sharp corners, or sources of pollution. The office building is still in a prosperous position, and the trees planted in the yard are also very particular."

Having said this, Zhao Ankun turned to Liu Hang and asked: "Boss Liu, did you ask a Feng Shui master to see the layout of your factory?"

Liu Hang quickly shook his head and said, "This is how it is when I rent it. It has not been changed. I heard that the layout of the entire park was designed by the owner of the industrial park."

Zhao Ankun nodded, "That's right, I definitely asked for guidance from an expert here."

Wu Jiang frowned and made another guess: "Uncle Zhao, since you can't see the problem, has Brother Liu offended someone and someone deliberately harmed him secretly?"

Before Zhao Ankun could speak this time, Liu Hang shook his head and rejected it.

"It shouldn't be. I'm just a small boss, and I've never offended anyone. Who would harm me when they have nothing to do?"

Zhao Ankun also agreed with his statement. Even though Liu Hang could earn several million a year, in the Shenzhen city, there are a lot of people who earn more than him. If it is really artificial, the price is definitely not small.

Wu Jiang put forward another point of view, "Since there is no problem with the Yangzhai and the factory, is there something wrong with the Yinzhai?"

This is what Zhao Ankun is confused about. Problems in the ghost house will indeed affect the fortunes of future generations, but generally speaking, if there are problems in the ghost house, the reaction will be on the descendants, such as the offspring losing money, getting sick, and having everything go wrong.

Liu Hang's company can meet these requirements, but his company's employees frequently have accidents, which makes no sense.

Zhao Ankun expressed his thoughts and now reached a deadlock again.

Zhao Ankun frowned, clasped his hands behind his back, and paced repeatedly. After a while, he finally made up his mind: "Boss Liu, now that the situation has come to a point, I can only go and see your ghost house. Where is your ancestral grave? Has there been any change recently?"

Hearing this, Liu Hang quickly said: "Master Zhao, my ancestral grave is in my hometown, also in Cangming County. During the Chinese New Year, my dad went to pay homage and found nothing unusual."
